messages:
alex: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

alex: what I did: landed kernel queue refactor (PR #4382), ran microbench for batching, removed a double-lock that was stalling the slot allocator.
alex: blocker: seeing a p95 latency spike when slot-steal > 0.7 during mixed small+long requests. need to triage before can safely roll.
alex: today: run canary, gather tracing snapshot + perf record, try smaller max_batch_wait if needed, request review on the PR.

maya: nice work. i can review PR tonight. do you have a repro script for the spike?

alex: repro command I used: `./bench/run_batch_perf.sh --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --concurrency 4`
alex: snippet from the tail of the run:
```
[run] requests: 5k, kv_miss_ratio=0.21
latencies_ms: p50=14, p90=78, p95=274, p99=920
stack: kernel->batcher->slot_steal->lock_try
```

devon: I ran a focused run with kv-hot on, saw similar tail. quick numbers: p50=12ms p95=280ms when cache_miss_ratio ~0.23.
devon: looks like eviction churn + slot steal amplifies serialization. suggest increasing prefetch_window from 1->3 as an experiment.

maya: pinging @sophie for tracing help and to correlate with hot-key evictions.

sophie: on it. can you also grab `perf record --call-graph` for one of the high-tail requests? that helps me see kernel vs user hot paths.
sophie: also, if you can enable structured traces (trace_id in the bench run) I can link spans to eviction events.

ops-bot: canary deployment requested by alex. starting canary: id=c-2026-03-17T09:12, route=canary, model=llama-13b-quant, targets=2 gpus. ETA ~7m.

alex: thanks ops-bot. also blocked by flaky infra CI on one windows worker that times out at `make bench` step — filed INF-210.

devon: left an inline on the PR about reducing lock granularity in slot allocator. added a tiny sim test: `tests/slot_steal_sim.py` to reproduce high contention quickly.
devon: quick command: `python tests/slot_steal_sim.py --slots 128 --workers 64` produces >50% contention in ~30s on my laptop.

alex: awesome, thanks. plan for today: run the canary, run bench across 2 gpu instances, collect perf/traces, try max_batch_wait 12ms -> 6ms, and try prefetch_window 1 -> 3. if p95 stays >200ms fallback policy: reduce batch size automatically.

maya: i can draft the rollout policy JSON and the canary monitor (latency/p95, error-rate). ping me when canary is green and you want to push.

sophie: small suggestion — if eviction rate correlates, consider a temporary kv grace window to reduce immediate evictions during slot steal bursts.

alex: will try both toggles and post results here. will also mention INF-210 in PR description.

alex: thanks all — i'll post bench results and tracing links after the canary completes. :thumbsup:
